brief.en: Breaths fire in an area in front of it

description.en: Snapdragons breathe fire that causes damage in 6 adjacent tiles.
description.zh: 火龙草向毗邻的 6 格吐出有伤害的火焰。

chat.en: Although the most powerful dragon in the plant kingdom, he still dreams of wings and seeing the world beneath him.
chat.zh: 就算他是植物王国里最强大的一条龙，他仍然希望有一对翅膀，俯瞰整个世界。

text.en: damages all zombies in the 6 tiles in front of it
text.zh: 对身前 6 个格子内的所有僵尸造成伤害
